Spectral-Density Data

Build, reshape, and serialize spectral-density and relaxation term tables.

make_spec_den_data()
Create data structures for calculating sigma/rho from dipole-dipole interaction tensors
make_r1_spec_den_term_array()
Make spectral density term array for heteronuclear R1 relaxation
make_r2_spec_den_term_array()
Make spectral density term array for heteronuclear R2 relaxation
make_sigma_spec_den_term_array()
Make spectral density term array for dipolar sigma cross relaxation
atom_relax_columns_to_spec_den_term_array()
Convert one rate block of atom-relax columns into a spectral-density term array
atom_relax_df_to_spec_den_term_array_list()
Convert atom-relax columns into a named list of spectral-density term arrays
spec_den_term_array_list_to_atom_relax_df()
Convert a named list of spectral-density term arrays into atom-relax columns
spec_den_term_array_to_atom_relax_columns()
Convert a spectral-density term array into one rate block of atom-relax columns
read_spec_den_data()
Read data for calculating spectral density functions
read_spec_den_relax_data()
Read data for calculating spectral-density-based relaxation rates
write_spec_den_relax_data()
Write data for calculating spectral-density-based relaxation rates
make_spec_den_relax_data()
Build spectral-density relaxation data from expanded atom-pair input
noe_to_sigma()
Convert steady-state NOE values to sigma cross-relaxation rates

Kinetic Ensemble Coordinate-Based Calculations

Compute grouped restraints and relaxation rates directly from coordinate ensembles.

coord_array_to_g_energy()
Calculate g value restraint energy from atomic coordinates
coord_array_to_g_energy_refactored()
Calculate g value restraint energy from atomic coordinates
coord_array_to_g_matrix()
Calculate group norm squared values from atomic coordinates
coord_array_to_sigma()
Calculate cross relaxation rates from atomic coordinates
coord_array_to_sigma_energy()
Calculate sigma restraint energy from atomic coordinates
coord_array_to_relax()
Calculate relaxation rates from atomic coordinates
coord_array_to_relax_energy()
Calculate relaxation rate restraint energy from atomic coordinates
g_to_energy()
Calculate restraint energy from group norm squared values
quadratic_loss()
Quadratic loss function
power_scale()
Scale real or back calculated values towards zero by taking a power
power_scaled_loss()
Traditional squared loss function scaled by a power

pdb_traj_close()
Close a PDB trajectory file
pdb_traj_d()
Calculate second-rank dipole interaction tensors
pdb_traj_dacf()
Calculate second-rank dipolar autocorrelation functions
pdb_traj_open()
Open a PDB trajectory file for reading
pdb_traj_read()
Read coordinates from the trajectory
noe_dacf_kernel()
Calculate kernel weights for determining NOE sigma and rho from a dipolar autocorrelation function

Kinetic Ensemble Core

Core numerical methods underlying the Kinetic Ensemble calculation, transforming coordinates into tensors, mode amplitudes, and the quantities that drive the coordinate-based calculations.

coord_array_to_r_array()
Calculate internuclear vectors from atomic coordinates
coord_array_to_r_array_backprop()
Back-propagate energy derivative from r array to coordinates
r_array_to_d_array()
Calculate dipole-dipole interaction tensors from internuclear vectors
r_array_to_d_array_backprop()
Back-propagate energy derivative from d array to r array
d_array_to_g()
Calculate group norm squared from dipole-dipole interaction tensors
d_array_to_g_matrix()
Calculate group norm squared from dipole-dipole interaction tensors
d_array_to_g_matrix_backprop()
Back-propagate energy derivative from g matrix to d array
g_matrix_to_a_matrix()
Calculate matrix of a values from a matrix of g values
g_matrix_to_a_matrix_backprop()
Back-propagate energy derivative from a matrix to g matrix
dxyz_dunit_to_overall_modes()
Calculate overall tumbling modes from diffusion tensor principal values
a_matrix_to_relax()
Calculate relaxation rates from spectral density functions with internal and overall motion
a_matrix_to_relax_backprop()
Back-propagate energy derivative from relaxation rates to a matrix
a_matrix_to_sigma()
Calculate sigma from a matrix of a values
a_matrix_to_sigma_backprop()
Back-propagate energy derivative from sigma to a matrix
euler_zyz_matrix()
Construct a ZYZ Euler rotation matrix
d_real_rank2()
Construct the real rank-2 rotation matrix
collapse_array()
Collapse first two dimensions of an array
array_shift()
Shift from one array dimension to another
deriv_check()
Check analytical derivatives via finite difference approximation

Permutations And Rate Models

Build symmetry-aware permutation maps, transition-rate matrices, and kinetic ensemble metadata.

find_aromatic_permutations()
Find permutations to coordinates of phenylalanine and tyrosine rings
find_methyl_permutations()
Find permutations to coordinates of XH3 groups
make_atom_perm_list()
Create list of matrices for doing two or three atom permutations
unique_atom_map()
Generate matrix of possible permuted assignments to individual atoms in a group
unique_atom_pair_map()
Generate matrix of possible permuted assignments of atom pairs within a group
rate_mat_diag()
Update transition rate diagonal using rates
rate_mat_intra_inter()
Create hierarchical transition rate matrix
rate_mat_kronecker()
Calculate Kronecker product of two transition rate matrices
rate_mat_simple()
Create transition rate matrix with single rate
get_rate_count_mat()
Get counts enabling calculation of eigenvalues from individual rates
get_rate_data()
Construct k coefficients in a recursive manner
get_rate_groups()
Find groups of numerically equivalent rates (degenerate eigenvalues)
get_eigen_groups()
Get k coefficients for creating linear combinations of a values from g values
calc_subset_mat()
Determine subsets of states within transition rate matrices
expand_subset_mat()
Expand subset matrix consistent with applying Kronecker product to original rate matrix
subset_idx_to_grouping_mat()
Convert a list of subset groups into a matrix with group indices
rate_data_to_mat_list()
Convert rate data into a format more easily serializable to set of tables
make_equiv_list()
Create list of equivalent atoms
equiv_list_name()
Update names of equivalent atoms
make_ke_data()
Encapsulate kinetic ensemble data into a list data structure
